name: Audio pipeline (ElevenLabs)
whatItIs: Sound effects, music and character voice lines from ElevenLabs in the bible's audio style, finished to loudness-normalized OGG (music with loop points). Voice lines use one fixed voice ID per character from the bible and are batched behind one approval.
gotchas: Live ElevenLabs calls not yet exercised with a real key; endpoints and prices in studio/services.json are unverified.
Game events play assets by tag: sfx:attack, sfx:hit, sfx:hurt, sfx:miss, sfx:pickup, sfx:defeat, sfx:descend, sfx:death, sfx:victory, music:explore.
